description: Get a single contact in a list. Returns email_address, fields, tags, status, and created_at. `contact_id` is the MD5 hash of the lowercased email address, or the `id` returned by emailoctopus_list_contacts. EmailOctopus: GET /lists/{list_id}/contacts/{contact_id}.

contact_id.description: The contact's id — the MD5 hash of the lowercased email address, or the id from list_contacts.

name: emailoctopus_get_contact
title: Get contact
